strings.리코? 무슨 생각을 그렇게 해요?: Rico? What are you thinking so hard about?
strings.아, %s 님…. 아직 관문에 계셨나요?: Oh, %s... You're still at the gateway?
I was just taking in the scenery.
It's nothing, really. I was thinking I want to go to sleep.
strings.관문에서 제공해준 숙소가 불편해요?: Is the lodging they provided at the gateway uncomfortable?
It's comfortable, but I can't sleep soundly when it isn't my own room.
I can only sleep deeply in my room full of dolls, in my soft, fluffy bed.
I don't have nightmares... If I feel even a little uneasy, I can't fall asleep...
strings.평소 악몽을 많이 꿔요?: Do you usually have a lot of nightmares?
strings.이 일을 하기 전에 제 모습, 그런 제가 있던 시간들이 계속해서 꿈으로: I keep dreaming of who I was before I started this work, and the days I spent back then. Most people who use this kind of power probably do...
strings.잠을 푹 자면 그런 생각도 들지 않을텐데…. 여기 와선 계속 그래서 조금: If I could sleep well, I wouldn't think about those things... But it keeps happening since I came here. It's been a little hard.
I think I could fall asleep right away if I hugged a pretty, cute doll.
Though dolls do look a little different to me after what happened on the island...
strings.하하하…. 그래도 쉴 때 조금이라도 자두는 게 어때요?: Hahaha... Still, why not try to sleep a little whenever you rest?
strings.라클렛이 만들어준 건데…, 그게 없어서 그런가봐요…. 아이 같죠. 사실: Raclette made it for me... Maybe that's why... I'm like a little child, aren't I? Though I suppose I really am still a child...
strings.다들 아끼는 물건 하나 둘쯤은 있잖아요. 그런 거죠?: Everyone has one or two things they treasure. It's like that, right?
strings.(헤이든에게 가서 괜찮은 인형이 있나 물어볼까?): (Should I ask Hayden if there are any nice dolls?)
I just remembered something I need to do.
Did you? You must be busy. I've kept you here too long.
Not at all. I'll be back as soon as I can.
Back from where? Oh, you've already gone.
Oh... You're heading toward the gate. Could it be...?
strings.(헤이든이 다가와 인사를 한다. 헤이든을 따라서 헤이든이 안고 있는 마리: (Hayden approaches and greets the adventurer. In Hayden's arms, Marie blinks as if offering a greeting too.)
Oh, I came because I have a favor to ask.
Please tell me. I'll help with anything I can.
strings.(헤이든에게 리코타의 상황을 간단하게 이야기한다.): (You briefly explain Licota's situation to Hayden.)
So the knight needs a nice doll. As for dolls we still have...
strings.정령들이 들어가 살고 있는 그런 거 밖에 없는데…. 그 아이들에게 이야: They're all ones with spirits living inside... If I ask them, they'll pretend to be dead.
We can't ask living spirits to stay dead.
strings.피쿠스 님이 저주에 걸렸을 때, 많은 인형들을 도와주셨어요. 솜을 넣고: When Picus was cursed, he helped many dolls. He's wonderfully skilled at stuffing them and sewing them up.
strings.피쿠스…라면 딱따구리 같이 생긴 그 새 인형 말하는 거죠?: Picus... You mean that bird doll that looks like a woodpecker?
strings.정확히는 섬에 살고 있던 투칸이라는 새랍니다. 피쿠스 님도 원래 훤칠하신: More precisely, he's a toucan, a bird that lived on the island. Picus was originally a tall, handsome man, but Circe cursed him when he rejected her.
strings.원래 이곳에 계신 분은 아니었는데, 어쩌다보니 계속 머물고 계세요. 강력: He wasn't originally from here, but somehow he ended up staying. The curse is so powerful that it remains even after Circe disappeared.
Isn't there any way to break the curse...?
...A curse that can affect an incarnate god seems to require power on the level of a god.
strings.아, 그러고보니 피쿠스 님이 최근에 인형을 만들어주셨어요. 인형이 된 모: Oh, that reminds me. Picus made some dolls recently. He seems to have taken a liking to his doll form.
strings.특히 스킬라 님께서 좋아하셔서 잔뜩 들고 가셨어요. 보고만 있어도 편해지: Scylla especially liked them and took a whole armful. She said just looking at them made her feel at ease.
strings.…편한 인형이라…. 하나 달라고 해볼까?: ...A comforting doll... Maybe I should ask for one.
She wants to help you, so she might give you one.
strings.그래야겠어요. 헤이든, 지금 스킬라 님은 어디 계세요?: I'll do that. Hayden, where is Scylla now?
strings.지금 심연의 거울 안에 계세요. 극장을 정비하고 계신 글라우코스 님에게: She's inside the Mirror of the Abyss. She said she didn't want to get in Glaucos's way while he works on the theater.
Then I'll go see her. Thank you.
Good luck. Come on, Marie. Let's wish the adventurer luck together.
strings.(조금 불안하긴 하지만, 빨리 가볼까?): (I'm a little uneasy, but shall we hurry over?)
strings.(거울 안은 여전히 여러가지 색을 머금은 유리와 구슬, 그리고 온갖 거울: (The mirror's interior is still filled with glass and beads in myriad colors, and mirrors of every kind. Among them stands Scylla in her doll hat, as though she has been waiting.)
strings.…강한 존재가 오는 것 같아서 대비하고 있었는데…. 너였구나, 여신의 모: ...I sensed a powerful presence approaching and was preparing myself... So it was you, the goddess's adventurer.
strings.안녕하세요, 스킬라 님. 그 일 이후로는 처음이죠?: Hello, Scylla. This is the first time since all that happened, isn't it?
I've wanted to talk with you about so many things. Thank you for coming.
strings.보다시피 키르케의 저주가 풀리진 않았지만…. 괜찮아. 글라우코스와 사이도: As you can see, Circe's curse hasn't been broken... But I'm all right. Glaucos and I are closer now, too.
strings.내가 조금 더 힘이 있었더라면 키르케를 그렇게 두지 않았을텐데…. 키르케: If only I'd had a little more strength, I wouldn't have let Circe go on like that... Circe...
strings.(스킬라의 눈에 왠지 모를 쓸쓸함이 느껴진다.): (An inexplicable loneliness appears in Scylla's eyes.)
Thank you so much for driving Circe off this island.
It was nothing. I'm glad you're all right.
strings.문득 널 보니 오래 전에 함께 했던 동료들이 생각나네…. 우리는 신의 뜻: Seeing you suddenly reminds me of the companions I had long ago... Following the will of the gods, we fought demons and devils who sought to devour the continent.
It was so long ago that I no longer even remember when...
The demons opened a gate and poured immense power into trying to seize Freios.
Demons like Degos, then. So they appeared back then and vanished...
strings.(스킬라에게 예전에 데고스와 있었던 일을 이야기한다.): (You tell Scylla about your past encounter with Degos.)
Degos has returned, and the gate has connected...
strings.그래도 다행이야. 네가 신을 따르는 사람이라서…. 데고스가 빠른 시일 안: Still, I'm glad. Glad you are someone who follows a god... Degos won't return any time soon, but others will surely take his place...
strings.왠지 넌 계속해서 만날 거 같아. 나도 돕고 싶지만, 지금 이런 몸이라: Somehow, I think you'll keep encountering them. I'd like to help, but it's difficult in this body. The curse will break someday, but I have no idea when.
strings.일단 재활하면서 기다릴건데…. 조금 도와줄래? 날 도와주면 필요한 걸 줄: For now, I'll work on recovering while I wait... Will you help me a little? If you do, I'll give you what you need.
...So you knew when you made that offer.
Otherwise, you would have no reason to come all the way back here.
strings.(스킬라가 여유있는 표정으로 모험가를 바라본다.): (Scylla looks at the adventurer with an unhurried expression.)
strings.피쿠스 인형 하나만 부탁드릴게요. 섬에 있었던 일을 도와준 친구에게 선물: I'd like just one Picus doll. I want to give it to a friend who helped with what happened on the island.
Is that all? I'd like to give my benefactor something better...
It's all right. I only need something useful right now.
strings.네가 그렇게 말하니 어쩔 수 없네. 알았어. 그러면 제일 안에 거울 세워: If you insist, I can't argue. All right. You know the place deepest inside, where the mirrors stand? Come there and spar with me.
strings.(말이 끝나기 무섭게 스킬라가 빠른 속도로 거울들이 가득한 공간 어딘가를: (No sooner has she finished speaking than Scylla races off somewhere among the mirrors.)
I'd better go too. I need to get the doll and return quickly.
Oh, right. I forgot that Scylla is a pretty formidable opponent...
strings.(%s의 공격을 막아낸 스킬라가 지쳤는지 그대로 주저앉는다.): (After blocking %s's attack, Scylla sinks to the ground, apparently exhausted.)
strings.내가 졌어. 덕분에 많이 느꼈어. 나는 아직도 부족해서 계속 단련해야 한: I lost. Thanks to you, I've learned a lot. I still have a long way to go and need to keep training.
strings.%s, 넌 정말 특별해. 키르케에게 세뇌당해 움직이지 못했을 때, 네 공: %s, you truly are special. When Circe's brainwashing left me unable to act, your attacks helped me wake up.
As promised, I'll give you a Picus doll. It should bring sweet dreams.
strings.(스킬라가 벽에 세워져 있는 유리에 손을 뻗더니 뒤적뒤적 거린다.): (Scylla reaches into a pane of glass standing against the wall and rummages around.)
strings.커다란 가방 같은 거라고 생각하면 돼. 키르케가 만든 공간이지만, 은근: Think of it as a large bag. Circe made this space, but it's surprisingly useful. You can put all sorts of things in and take them out...
strings.사람이나 동물 같이 살아있는 존재도 들어갈 수 있어. 봤잖아. 그 아이가: Living beings, like people and animals, can go inside too. You saw that child go in and put on that clumsy performance...
strings.(스킬라가 환한 표정으로 거울 속에서 손을 뺀다. 바보 같은 표정의 새: (Beaming, Scylla pulls her hand from the mirror, bringing out a bird-shaped doll with a silly expression.)
Oh, this is it. It's better made than I expected.
strings.그렇지? 피쿠스는 지금 인형이지만, 정말 재주가 많아. 정령인 카넨스가: Isn't it? Picus may be a doll now, but he has so many talents. You can see why the spirit Canens fell for him.
strings.재봉과 재단에 솜씨가 좋아서 인형의 옷을 만들고 터진 부분을 수선하고,: He's good at sewing and tailoring, making clothes for dolls and mending torn seams. He gardens, does plasterwork, and even knows perfumery. Impressive, isn't he?
strings.이 인형을 만들면서 피로를 덜어주는 향까지 집어넣었대. 아이에 섬의 식물: He said he added a fragrance that relieves fatigue when he made this doll. Apparently the plants on Aie Island have special scents, though I don't know much about them.
It smells like a cool sea breeze.
Doesn't it? Long ago, this place was an island surrounded by the sea.
strings.난 나중에 와서 그 모습을 보지 못했지만, 글라우코스가 이야기해주는 걸: I came later, so I never saw it that way, but from what Glaucos tells me, it was breathtakingly beautiful.
Give it to your friend, and they'll be able to fall asleep in no time.
strings.내가 더 고마워. 그동안 이야기하고 싶은게 많았는데, 이렇게 상대해줘서: I'm the one who should thank you. I've had so much I wanted to talk about. Thank you for keeping me company.
strings.나도 이렇게 내가 수다쟁이일 줄 몰랐어. 정말 오랜만에 다른 사람하고 이: I never knew I was such a chatterbox. It's been so long since I talked with someone else. I'm happy. This was fun.
It's just me today, but next time, let's meet with Glaucos too.
So the opening of the gate is what set the witches in motion...
And to think you met Degos... Hmm...
Rico, you're still here. Here you go...
strings.(리코타에게 피쿠스 미니 인형을 건네준다. 실물 모델인 피쿠스보다는 작지: (You hand Licota a miniature Picus doll. It is smaller than Picus himself, but just the right size for Licota to hug.)
strings.(리코타가 아무런 말도 하지 않은 채로 인형을 빤히 보고 있다.): (Licota stares at the doll without a word.)
strings.죄송해요. 너무 좋아요…. 너무 예뻐요. 너무 귀여워요…. 저 어떻게 해: I'm sorry. I love it... It's so pretty. So cute... What am I supposed to do?
strings.(조금은 무뚝뚝해 보이던 소녀가 격한 감정을 억누르지 못한 채 인형을 놓: (The seemingly reserved girl cannot contain her excitement or let go of the doll.)
strings.%s 님, 고마워요. 살아있는, 아니…. 죽어있는…. 아니. 그냥 인형인: Thank you, %s. A living... No, a dead... No. It's just a doll, but such a beautiful one.
strings.너무 푹신푹신해서 좋아요. …라클렛이 만들어준 인형도 좋았는데, 이것도: I love how soft and fluffy it is... I love the doll Raclette made me, but I love this one too...
strings.불길한 기운 같은 것도 느껴지지 않고, 만든 사람의 실력과 애정만 느껴져: I don't feel any ominous energy from it, only the maker's skill and affection. I love that...
...Oh, I don't know. I love everything about it. What am I supposed to do...?
strings.(리코타가 인형을 푹 껴안은 채로 어쩔 줄 몰라한다.): (Licota hugs the doll tightly, unsure what to do with herself.)
I'm glad. I was worried you might not like it...
strings.이런 인형이라면 잠이 잘 올 거 같아요. 게다가 좋은 냄새가 나요. 바다: I think I'll sleep well with a doll like this. And it smells so nice. Like the sea... Like my hometown...
strings.(리코타가 살짝 쓸쓸한 미소를 짓는다.): (Licota smiles with a hint of sadness.)
strings.살짝 그리운 냄새가 나서 조금 설렜나봐요. 죄송해요. 제가 너무 지쳐 있: The familiar scent must have made me a little excited. I'm sorry. I suppose I was really worn out.
I don't usually show this side of myself...
It's all right, Rico. Loving something you love is a happy thing.
I'll head back to my lodgings. I'm suddenly getting sleepy...
strings.(나중에 듣게 된 이야기지만, 그날 리코타는 잠의 요정이 온 힘을 쏟아: (You hear later that Licota slept deeply that day, without a thought in her head, as though a sleep fairy had put all its strength into sending her to sleep.)
strings.(리코타를 보내자, 갑자기 위에서 요상한 모양의 생물이 기다리고 있었던: (After Licota leaves, a strangely shaped creature suddenly flies down in front of %s, as if it has been waiting.)
strings.나만 보이는 정령인가?: Is it a spirit only I can see?
strings.뭐라고 하는 거야? 푸. 놈. 아? 푸놈아가 뭐야? 아, 프뉴마…. 맞다: What are you saying? Puh. Num. Ah? What's Puh-num-ah? Oh, Pneuma... That's right?
strings.프뉴마에서 아르케가 날 찾는 건가?: Arche is looking for me in Pneuma?
